summary: Iteration-8 backend-only regression for KasirKu Pro session 2026-10 iter-8 (frontend-only polish release). ALL 157/157 tests PASS (153 carried-over + 4 new iter-8) when run serially with `-o addopts=`. iter-8 ships ZERO backend changes — only FE polish (debt payment UI excludes 'credit', receipt share/A4 buttons removed, Preview struk guards web, parked resume consumedParkedRef guard, scanner camera on cart floating card). Re-ran full regression suite + added 4 focused tests that pin the backend contracts the FE fixes depend on: (1) Parked EDIT flow — DELETE old parked /api/parked/{id} then POST /api/parked with customer_id + price_level_id persists both fields atomically (verified via LIST). Old id removed, new id returned 200 with price_level_id='grosir' and customer_id set. (2) Stale parked DELETE returns exactly `404 'Antrian tidak ditemukan'` — this is the error the FE consumedParkedRef must swallow after sale success. Verified both re-delete of consumed id AND random uuid return 404. (3) Backend does NOT auto-delete parked on sale creation — proved parked row still exists after POST /api/transactions, confirming FE still owns the DELETE call and must be idempotent against 404 (which is exactly what iter-8 consumedParkedRef fixes). (4) /api/transactions/{id}/pay still accepts payment_method + payment_method_label (iter-7 contract carry — 200 with outstanding=0, payment entry contains both fields). All iter-5 regressions verified via full-suite pass: multi-unit sale qty 1 Dus (factor 12) decrements stock by 12 (test_goods_sale_with_unit_factor_decrements_by_qty_times_factor); service products skip stock delta; /reports/sales-items daily returns flat list with product_id/operator_id filters; /transactions?kind=sale list works; /customers price_level_id persisted. iter-7 regressions: audit-logs owner-only 403 for cashier, reset_transactions/delete_all_products write exactly one audit entry each, PUT /profile username case-insensitive clash → 400, <3 chars → 422, old username can't login after change. No backend regressions introduced by iter-8 UI work (as expected since server.py untouched between iter-7 and iter-8).

minor.issue: 404 response body is a JSON string 'Antrian tidak ditemukan' rather than a stable error code — the FE consumedParkedRef guard is now relied upon as the ONLY safeguard against user-visible toasts. Consider adding an idempotent flag (e.g. ?idempotent=true -> 200 with {deleted:false}) OR a typed error code like {code:'PARKED_NOT_FOUND'} so future clients can discriminate without string-matching Indonesian copy.

No server-side de-dup / optimistic version — the EDIT flow (DELETE old + POST new) is non-atomic server-side. If the DELETE succeeds but POST fails (network/network), the user loses the parked silently. Not blocking current UX but a future PUT /api/parked/{id} would be safer.
Still no action/date filters or pagination cursor (iter-7 carry).
payment_method_label still defaults to raw method key when omitted (iter-7 carry).

action_items: (Carried) /app/backend/pytest.ini still ships `-n 2 --dist loadscope`; must run full regression with `-o addopts=` to avoid iter-5 cross-worker state collisions. Not a product bug but a long-standing test-runner config issue.
(Carried) server.py is 1457 lines — above 700-line soft limit. Split into routers (auth / products / transactions / admin / reports / settings / parked / audit).
(Optional) DELETE /api/parked/{id}: make idempotent OR return typed error code so FE doesn't string-match 'Antrian tidak ditemukan'.
(Optional) Add PUT /api/parked/{id} to replace the DELETE+POST edit pattern atomically.
(Optional, carried) Audit log filter/pagination; resolve payment_method_label from configured methods when omitted.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:1298-1304 (DELETE /parked/{id}): Correctly returns 404 with detail 'Antrian tidak ditemukan' when row absent. This is the exact error the FE iter-8 consumedParkedRef must suppress after sale completion. Behavior verified.
server.py:1290-1296 (POST /parked): Accepts customer_id + price_level_id via ParkedTransactionInput and persists them verbatim; LIST returns them. Edit flow (DELETE+POST) works but is non-atomic.
server.py:111-121 (ParkedTransactionInput): customer_id Optional[str], price_level_id default 'default', items List[TransactionItem]. Good schema.
server.py:593-625 (pay_debt): Unchanged from iter-7, still correctly carries payment_method + payment_method_label into transaction.payments[] and cash_entries note.
No backend code changes between iter-7 and iter-8 (verified by diff of imports/routes/models) — frontend-only iteration as advertised.

Backend does NOT auto-delete parked when a transaction with the same items is created — this is by design (parked and transactions are decoupled collections). FE must call DELETE after sale success and handle 404 gracefully.
